To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the v2RDM approach to electronic structure theory is a promising new tool for the study of large molecular systems, and that the v2-RDM approach is capable of providing accurate descriptions of equilibrium molecular geometries.

(1) analytic energy gradients for variational 2RDM-driven complete active space self consistent field (v2RMD-CASSCF) theory have been derived; (2) these gradients can be computed with the same computational cost as conventional CASSCF gradients; (3) v2RDM- and CI-driven CACSF theory yield very similar equilibrium structures for small molecules; (4) v2RMD- and CI-driven methods yield similar geometries for pentacene, but

the v2RDM method can provide accurate analytic energy gradients for CASSCF calculations, with errors that are comparable to those of the full CI method, and that enforcing three-particle conditions on the 2-RDM leads to improved accuracy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of a variational two-particle-reduced-density-matrix-driven complete active space self- consistent field (v2R-DM-CAS-SCF) method.
a variational two-particle reduced-density-matrix approach to electronic-structure theory.
a variational two-reduced-density-matrix (v2Rdm) method, which has recently been developed for electronic structure calculations of molecules.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
enforcing partial three-particles N-representability is a necessary condition to achieve the accuracy of conventional CI-driven CASSCM.

the variational two-electrons reduced density matrix (v2RMD) driven CASSCF approach, when enforcing partial three-particles N-representability, yields geometries of small molecules that are comparable to those obtained from conventional CASSCF, and that the v2RMD driven CASSCF method is capable of yielding accurate geometries of larger molecules.
the variational 2RDM-CAS approach is competitive with the standard CI-CAS approach in terms of accuracy of the optimized geometries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
v2RDM-based methods are a promising alternative to CI-based methods for the computation of equilibrium molecular geometries.
the variational v2RDM-driven approach is a viable alternative for the optimization of molecular geometries.
v2RDM-driven CASSCF with three-particle conditions is the most promising for applications to larger systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the v2RDM approach is a promising alternative to CI-driven methods for the optimization of large active spaces.
the v2RDM-driven CASSCF method is capable of producing accurate equilibrium structures for small- and medium-sized systems.
the v2RDM approach is competitive with CI-driven methods in terms of accuracy, while also providing a more rigorous description of electronic structure.
